mapper.select: SELECT record_status circuit_state,record_version consecutive_failures FROM t_system_config WHERE config_key='REPORT_AI_HEALTH:REPORT_NARRATION' AND config_version='state-v1' FOR UPDATE
SELECT effective_to<=NOW(3) FROM t_system_config WHERE config_key='REPORT_AI_HEALTH:REPORT_NARRATION' AND config_version='state-v1'
mapper.update: UPDATE t_system_config SET config_subtype='HALF_OPEN',record_status='HALF_OPEN',updated_at=NOW(3) WHERE config_key='REPORT_AI_HEALTH:REPORT_NARRATION' AND config_version='state-v1'

UPDATE t_system_config SET config_subtype='CLOSED',record_status='CLOSED',record_version=0,effective_to=NULL,config_desc=NULL,config_value=JSON_OBJECT('lastSuccessAt',NOW(3)),updated_at=NOW(3) WHERE config_key='REPORT_AI_HEALTH:REPORT_NARRATION' AND config_version='state-v1'

UPDATE t_system_config SET record_version=#{failures},config_desc=#{code},effective_from=NOW(3),config_subtype=#{state},record_status=#{state},effective_to=IF(#{open},DATE_ADD(NOW(3),INTERVAL 5 MINUTE),effective_to),updated_at=NOW(3) WHERE config_key='REPORT_AI_HEALTH:REPORT_NARRATION' AND config_version='state-v1'
